# 1 Clement Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** The ministers of the grace of God spoke through the Holy Spirit concerning repentance.

**8:2** And even the Master of all things spoke of repentance with an oath: "As I live, says the Lord, I desire not the death of the sinner as much as his repentance." And he added a gracious declaration: [Ezek 33:11]

**8:3** "Repent, O house of Israel, of your iniquity. Say to the sons of my people: Though your sins reach from the earth to the heaven, and though they be redder than scarlet and blacker than sackcloth, and you turn to me with a whole heart and say 'Father,' I will hearken to you as to a holy people." [Free citation combining Ezek 33:11 and Isa 1:18]

**8:4** And in another place he speaks thus: "Wash and be clean; put away your wickednesses from your souls before my eyes; cease from your wickednesses; learn to do good; seek out judgment; deliver him who is wronged; give judgment for the orphan, and do justice for the widow; and come and let us reason together, says he; and if your sins be as crimson, I will make them white as snow; and if they be as scarlet, I will make them white as wool; and if you are willing and hearken to me, you shall eat the good of the land; but if you are not willing and do not hearken to me, a sword shall devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things." [Isa 1:16-20 LXX]

---

*EMET: The composite quotation in 8:3 is not found in any single OT text; Clement appears to be citing a catechetical compilation or writing from memory. Verse 8:4 is a close rendering of LXX Isaiah 1:16-20.*
